description: This is an abstract base class for a Vert.x-based CoAP protocol adapter in a Hono IoT platform. It provides functionality for starting/stopping a CoAP server, configuring secure and insecure endpoints, managing resources, and handling message forwarding for telemetry and event data. It uses Californium library for CoAP and Scandium for DTLS security, and integrates with Hono's device provisioning, authentication, and messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a CoAP protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, managing CoAP server setup, resource configuration, message forwarding, and security concerns based on Vert.x and Californium libraries.

methods.name: setHonoDeviceResolver
methods.description: Sets the ApplicationLevelInfoSupplier used to resolve device identities for authenticated CoAP clients.

methods.name: setPskStore
methods.description: Configures the PskStore service for PSK-based DTLS authentication.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Injects or replaces the metrics reporting object for this adapter.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns the current metrics reporting object.

methods.name: setResources
methods.description: Adds a set of CoAP resources to be managed by this server.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default secure CoAP port, typically 5684.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default insecure CoAP port, typically 5683.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Retrieves the actual port number on which the secure endpoint is listening.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Retrieves the actual port number on which the insecure endpoint is listening.

methods.name: setCoapServer
methods.description: Sets a pre-configured CoapServer instance instead of creation during startup.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Starts the adapter, configuring and binding secure/insecure CoAP endpoints, and adding resources.

methods.name: addResources
methods.description: Adds configured resources to the CoAP server upon startup.

methods.name: bindSecureEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and binds a secure DTLS endpoint using configured credentials.

methods.name: bindInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and binds an insecure CoAP endpoint if configured.

methods.name: preStartup
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions before server startup.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after successful startup.

methods.name: getSecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Builds network configuration for secure endpoint with default and custom options.

methods.name: getInsecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Builds network configuration for insecure endpoint with default and custom options.

methods.name: loadNetworkConfig
methods.description: Loads network configuration properties from a specified file into the Californium NetworkConfig object.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Provides an extension point for subclasses to modify messages before sending downstream.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the CoAP server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions before shutdown.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook after shutdown completes.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedExtendedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies the authenticated device identity from a CoAP exchange.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Forwards telemetry data from a CoAP request to the messaging backend.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Forwards event data from a CoAP request to the messaging backend.

methods.name: doUploadMessage
methods.description: Handles forwarding of a message (telemetry or event) downstream, including validation and metrics.

methods.name: isGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if gateway mapping is enabled; defaults to true.
